summary: The diff implements String.prototype.charCodeAt steps 1-7 in order inside prototype_char_code_at.rs. Each step is kept as a comment above its code. RequireObjectCoercible and ToString run on this, ToIntegerOrInfinity runs on position, and the NaN range check comes before the code-unit read. The index is safe after that check, because position is an integer in [0, size). No test-shaped branches, no swallowed errors, no fabricated values. The only other change is renaming the unused new_target parameter to _new_target, which is needed now that it is unused. I could not verify that the helpers used (ops::require_object_coercible, ops::to_string, ops::to_integer_or_infinity, agent.str_len, agent.str, args.get_or_undefined) exist with the signatures assumed, but the build gate passed and the test262 result (+34, no regressions) is consistent with a correct implementation.
notes_for_next_attempt: No defects found. Nothing needs fixing. Optional: confirm that agent.str_len and agent.str return UTF-16 code-unit counts and slices, since the spec's "length" and "code unit" are defined in code units. The test262 result suggests they do.
